facts.text: The lodge is in the Nyamuma Hills in Serengeti National Park, Tanzania.
facts.excerpt: It is located at Meliá Serengeti Lodge, Nyamuma Hills, Serengeti National Park, 01184 Tanzania.

facts.text: The hotel is built using local natural materials, organic shapes and traditional Maasai colours.
facts.excerpt: The soul of the wild environment is evoked throughout the hotel, built using local natural materials, organic shapes and traditional Maasai colours.

facts.text: Rooms are inspired by Maasai traditions, with views of the hotel gardens or the Serengeti plains.
facts.excerpt: Elegant rooms inspired by Maasai traditions with spectacular views of the hotel gardens or the Serengeti plains.

facts.text: Some rooms have a balcony with views of the Mbalageti River Valley.
facts.excerpt: With a balcony with spectacular views of the Mbalageti River Valley, step into this bright room with contemporary decoration with colonial influences and hints of Maasai culture.

facts.text: The lodge has an infinity pool with views of the Serengeti.
facts.excerpt: The stunning infinity pool with views of the Serengeti, a relaxing spa, and a fully equipped gym complete this unforgettable adventure.

facts.text: Spa treatments come at an extra charge and are based on concepts combining beauty, harmony, vitality, nature and nutrition.
facts.excerpt: The Spa services (with extra charge) are based on essential concepts which combine beauty, harmony, vitality, nature and nutrition.

facts.text: At the gym, guests can also work out outside with views of the Serengeti.
facts.excerpt: where you can also work out outside and admire the stunning views of the Serengeti.

facts.text: The hotel offers a personalized butler service.
facts.excerpt: Among the services offered are: Personalized Butler Service, Infinity pool, Outdoor swimming pool

facts.text: The walking safari is a one-and-a-half-hour walk guided by experts, a local Maasai and a ranger.
facts.excerpt: A Serengeti walking safari offers an intimate, one-and-a-half-hour exploration of the wilderness, guided by experts, a local Maasai, and a ranger.

facts.text: Walking safari groups are limited to six people and only available to guests over 18.
facts.excerpt: Groups are limited to a maximum of 6 people and only available to those over the age of 18.

facts.text: The balloon safari flies over the Serengeti plains at dawn.
facts.excerpt: The Serengeti Balloon Safari offers a breathtaking journey over the plains at dawn, providing sweeping views of wildlife and landscapes bathed in golden light.

facts.text: The balloon safari includes a bush breakfast in the wilderness.
facts.excerpt: This serene adventure includes a gentle ascent, intimate wildlife encounters, and a bush breakfast in the heart of the wilderness.

facts.text: Game drives can be taken in a private vehicle, tailored to guests' interests and pace.
facts.excerpt: With the added flexibility of a private vehicle, each game drive is tailored to the guests

facts.text: The hotel offers a visit to the traditional Maasai village at Fort Ikoma.
facts.excerpt: Discover the authentic Maasai way of life with a visit to the traditional Maasai village at Fort Ikoma.

facts.text: The hotel offers Maasai cultural storytelling and lessons led by traditional warriors.
facts.excerpt: Join us for Maasai cultural storytelling and lessons led by our traditional warriors.

facts.text: Guests can join a live beading demonstration with the resident Maasai artist.
facts.excerpt: Take part in a live beading demonstration with our resident Maasai artist.

facts.text: A romantic dinner is served under the stars in a private gazebo overlooking the savannah.
facts.excerpt: Experience a romantic dinner under the stars in a private gazebo overlooking the savannah.

facts.text: Boma is an a la carte restaurant in a typical Maasai building with a fireplace and a terrace.
facts.excerpt: A typical Maasai building with a fireplace and a table area on the terrace, where you can try a wide range of African culinary creations.

facts.text: The colonial-style bar serves Tanzanian coffees and teas, spirits from across Africa and local gins.
facts.excerpt: A colonial-style bar which is open all day, serving a great choice of Tanzanian coffees and teas, exotic spirits from all over the continent and local brands of gin.

facts.text: The hotel offers activities for children.
facts.excerpt: Children will also enjoy their own little African adventure.

facts.text: The hotel is 36 km from Seronera Airport.
facts.excerpt: 36 km from Seronera Airport

facts.text: The hotel is 335 km from Arusha.
facts.excerpt: 335 km from Arusha

facts.text: Guests have free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Yes, guests staying at the hotel have free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.

facts.text: Safari Experience rooms include a half-day safari in a shared Jeep and a picnic in the savannah.
facts.excerpt: a half-day safari in a shared Jeep (per person per day), and a delicious picnic in the heart of the savannah

facts.text: Guests can take a charcoal pencil art class with the Resident Artist.
facts.excerpt: Get a taste of local art in a charcoal pencil art class with our Resident Artist.
